description: A painted interior of a ship cabin with round portholes, through which grey warships sit on calm water. Several men in dark military uniforms and red fezzes stand around a wooden table, where a man in a dark uniform with red collar tabs leans forward to sign papers. An older officer in a navy peaked cap and double-breasted coat with gold sleeve stripes stands at the right, and a map, an inkwell, a pen and a small brass item lie on the table. The scene is lit by a warm lamp, and there is a small mark in the bottom-right corner.
